build_vmc_loss: build a VMC loss function with custom gradients using make_loss for a FermiNet wavefunction network
build_wqmc_loss: build a WQMC loss function with weighted quasi-Monte Carlo gradients using make_wqmc_loss
build_energy_overlap_loss: build an energy overlap loss function for excited state optimization using make_energy_overlap_loss
clip_local_values: clip local operator estimates to remove outliers using clip_local_values with a configurable clip scale
review_auxiliarylossdata: review the AuxiliaryLossData dataclass to understand energy, variance, and overlap fields returned by loss functions
